newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE dollar futures most traded.
newsitem.headline: Forint firms vs dlr, BCE dollar futures most traded.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar on Tuesday as the U.S. unit came off its peak, dealers said.
"The forint followed the dollar/mark cross in average trade," said Adam Szilagyi of ABN AMRO.
The forint closed at 170.20/30 against the dollar compared with its opening of 170.50/55 and remained some 15 pips weaker than the central bank's bid.
The Hungarian unit floats against the central bank's currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
On the Budapest Commdity Exchange, most currency futures finished lower or remained steady, but the dollar continued to rise for all maturities.
Ecu futures dropped for all but one maturity, the German mark dropped for all, the Swiss franc's May and June maturities remained steady with all others easing.
Yen futures dropped for three maturities, sterling also dropped for two. The Italian lira remained unchanged.
Dollar futures were the most traded, accounting for 5,532 contracts of the total 10,955 contracts or 1.96 billion forints turnover.
